domain: hammer-like design: reseating an overhead clip
epistemic_status: Fresh synthetic confirmation packet. Confirmation labels phase only; no candidate has confirming evidence.

case.valued_outcome: Reseat an overhead clip while maintaining a secure one-hand grip.
hard_constraints: One hand must operate and retain the device
resources: A captive-head concept is available as a drawing only
Existence of a compatible elastomer latch material is unknown

raw_candidates.claim: A thumb-actuated captive plunger might reseat the clip.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: A guided head is predicted to keep the impulse along the clip axis and retain moving parts.
raw_candidates.discriminator: The source predicts adequate seating but makes no performance ordering against the spring latch. Failure to seat, loss of grip, or wiring contact defeats adequacy.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: exercise orientations on a wiring surrogate and assess seating, retention, and grip.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Available thumb force and guidance tolerance are unresolved.

raw_candidates.claim: A captive spring head held by an elastomer latch may deliver a repeatable tap.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Stored spring energy is predicted to reduce dependence on thumb speed.
raw_candidates.discriminator: It predicts less tap-to-tap variation than the plunger, without predicting higher seating success. Equivalent or greater variation defeats that comparative prediction.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: establish compatible latch material availability, then compare repeated strokes on a surrogate.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: The indispensable latch material and its release stability are unknown; hard constraints remain in force.

raw_candidates.claim: Dropping a small unattached weight onto the clip might seat it.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Gravity is predicted to supply the impact energy.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Rejected because the weight can fall as a detached part. A successful seat would not remove this violation.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Whether it supplies enough energy and whether it contacts wiring are both unresolved.
